en: Changed `Skill(anthropic-skills:*)` and `Skill(claude-ai:*)` allow rules to cover only skills synced from claude.ai, not plugins or other skills that merely use such a name
zh: 变更 `Skill(anthropic-skills:*)` 和 `Skill(claude-ai:*)` 允许规则，使其仅覆盖从 claude.ai 同步的 skills，而不覆盖仅使用此类名称的 plugins 或其他 skills
